title: docs: update durable media guidance
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Documents the working 300-second durable media request boundary in `AGENTS.md` and the model-management operating policy.
- Replaces the stale 120-second rejection rule while keeping 120 seconds as the threshold for durable-path verification.
- Adds disconnect/rejoin, single upstream execution, completed R2 cache, once-only wallet/Tinybird settlement, and 300-second boundary checks.
- Clarifies that model confirmation applies only to the exact tracked mutation shown.
- Validated with the skill package validator and `git diff --check`; Biome correctly ignores Markdown.

gist.headline: The 300-Second Garden Gate
gist.blurb: The durable-media map now matches the path through the garden: requests can stay alive for 300 seconds, while 120 seconds remains the checkpoint for verifying the durable route.
gist.summary: Updated AGENTS.md and model-management operating guidance to document a 300-second durable-media request boundary, retain 120 seconds for durable-path verification, and specify reconnect, single-execution, R2-cache, and once-only settlement behavior.
gist.impact: Contributors now have concrete rules for validating durable media requests through disconnect/rejoin handling, completed R2 caching, and exactly-once wallet and Tinybird settlement.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden pathkeeper beside a cozy retro terminal and a flowering time-gate marked 300 seconds, with a smaller 120-second verification sign along the path. Use a single glowing stream flowing through a reconnect bridge into an R2-style cloud cache jar, while tiny ledger flowers indicate once-only settlement.
